images.prompt: Close-up dynamic shot of the Dyson V10 Konical’s floor head actively cleaning a medium-pile carpet, with visible dirt and dust particles being lifted into the transparent bin. Bright, energetic mood conveying powerful performance.

images.prompt: A user’s hand pressing the release button to remove the battery pack from the Dyson V10 Konical. The battery pack is clearly labeled with capacity details.
